description: This file defines a React context for managing notes in a note-taking web application, including types, reducer logic, context creation, hooks, local storage persistence, and a utility to create new notes.

methods.name: notesReducer
methods.description: Reducer function to handle state updates for notes based on different actions like load, add, update, delete, select, and setQuery.

methods.name: loadFromStorage
methods.description: Utility function to load and validate notes data from local storage.

methods.name: persistToStorage
methods.description: Utility function to save notes data to local storage.

methods.name: useNotes
methods.description: Custom hook to access the notes context, providing notes state, dispatch function, and filtered notes.

methods.name: NotesProvider
methods.description: Context provider component that manages notes state, handles hydration from local storage, and provides context value.

methods.name: createNewNote
methods.description: Utility function to generate a new note with default values and unique ID.
